notes.subject: mothaladi o tla re
notes.rationale: Seheberu se na le אמר fela; mohlaladi o okeditšwe go fa sebopego polelong

notes.subject: אמר
notes.rationale: Mofetoledi ba fapana: 'mothaladi o tla re' (KJV), 'go bolelwa ka nna' (ASV), 'ba tla re ka nna' (JPS) — mo e ka bago mahlakore a mararo

notes.subject: tsedeke
notes.rationale: צדקות ke bontši; Sepedi se sa na le bontši bja lentšu leo, ka gobane 'tsedeke' e le lentšu le tee

translation: Fela go Yahwe, go nna, ⟨mothaladi o tla re⟩, go tšea tsedeke le maatla; go fihla go yena ⟨ba⟩ tla tla, gomme bao ba kgalalelagago go yena ka moka ba tla tshwarwa ke mahlatse.

tokens.gloss: gomme ba tla tshwarwa ke mahlatse
